summary: Backend-only verification of iteration-73 fixes in /app/backend/routes/staff.py. Created /app/backend/tests/test_iteration73_admin_gate.py (37 tests, 37 pass) covering the _verify_admin allowlist privesc fix, diagnose-otp projection, incentive-report limit bounds, and isinstance()-based 503 classification. Flipped the iter-72 xfail (TestAdminGateScope) to a live assertion — iter-72 suite now 23/23 PASS. Light cross-router regression (iter 70 edit-brand async write, iter 71 objstore uploads, iter 62 bill projections) = 54/54 PASS. No backend issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: _verify_admin falls back to the 'type' claim when 'role' is absent (role = payload.get('role') or payload.get('type')). Verified safe today: consumer tokens use type='consumer' and retailer/staff tokens set role explicitly, so nothing non-admin can enter the allowlist. Still worth narrowing to a single canonical claim to avoid future drift.
Role match is exact and case-sensitive: 'Admin' and 'admin_viewer' are rejected (verified) — intentional, but ensure any future admin-login path emits exactly 'admin'/'super_admin'/'mall_admin'.
Other admin routers outside routes/staff.py were not re-audited for a similar blacklist pattern; recommend a one-time grep for 'role != "retail_staff"'-style gates elsewhere.

rca_of_the_issue: Iter-72 privesc root cause was a blacklist gate in _verify_admin ('reject only retail_staff'); iter-73 replaced it with an exact-match allowlist ('admin','super_admin','mall_admin'), which fully closes the escalation path — confirmed by minting a real retailer_manager token via the OTP flow and receiving 403 on all admin staff routes.
